notes:
Sourced from Lab.gruppen's own official Technical Data Sheet (item no. TDS-PLM10000Q_V11, Copyright 2009 Lab.gruppen AB) — an older/legacy product no longer listed on the current labgruppen.com site (current site shows only newer PLM 8K44 BP / 12K44 SP models), so the datasheet PDF was retrieved via the Wayback Machine archive of the original manufacturer URL (labgruppen.com/downloads/product/...). Content and completeness are fully authoritative manufacturer data despite the archival retrieval method, hence "high" confidence.

Speaker output connectors are a factory-order-time choice: "Neutrik Speakon (1 x NLT8, 2 x NLT4) or 4 Binding Posts (pairs) (must be specified upon order)." This entry documents the Speakon variant (as pictured in the datasheet); the binding-post variant instead has 4 binding-post pairs (banana-compatible), one pair per output channel (CH1-CH4), in place of the 3 Speakon ports listed here.

Two separate hardware/mains variants exist: 230 V nominal (140-265 V, 2500 W, shown on the rear-panel silkscreen "200-240V 2500W 50-60Hz" in the datasheet) and 115 V nominal (70-135 V) — not user-selectable, ordered as distinct SKUs. Both use the same Neutrik PowerCon 32A mains connector.

No ports in this unit fall on a graded connector scale except the two EtherCon network ports (rated "Auto 10/100" = eth-100m per manufacturer spec); all XLR (analog and AES3) and Speakon/PowerCon connectors have grade intentionally omitted per the ungraded-connector-type rule. Unit also includes a 2.5" front-panel LCD and soft-button/rotary-encoder control interface (not physical signal/power I/O, so not listed as a port).
